title: Palaa tähän: return a conversation or its files to an earlier message (experimental)
description: The daemon's own Pi extension does the work in the person's Pi and records it in the same native session; the daemon only reads that record and asks the extension to act.

preview.description: GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/rewind?entry={entry_key}: what going back before one of the person's messages leaves behind, and what a file restore would change compared with the files as they are now: every file under the repository that the agent's runs changed from that message on when the message has a turn snapshot, and the files the agent's edit and write tools copied otherwise. checkpoint is false when neither was recorded for that message (the feature was off); the conversation can still go back.

path.description: Relative to the workspace, ~/ for the rest of the home, absolute elsewhere.

committed.description: A Git commit after the message changed the file. A restore never rewrites Git history: the change stays in its commit and the restored file becomes an uncommitted change against it. Absent when no such commit was found.

commands.description: Commands the agent ran after the message; a restore does not undo their effects.

branch.description: GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/rewind?branch={marker_key}: the continuation a rewind marker on the active branch replaced, oldest first, newest 200 entries.

turnChanges.description: GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/rewind?turn={entry_key}: the files the agent's run for one of the person's messages changed, from the turn snapshots recorded at the run's start and end (or the next run's start when it was steered or never settled: settled is false). snapshot is false when the turn has none to compare (recorded before the recorder, with Palaa tähän off, outside a Git repository, or a store the retention sweep removed); the browser then reads the turn's tool calls. skipped names paths the snapshots could not record.

path.description: Relative to the workspace, ~/ for the rest of the home, absolute elsewhere.

old_path.description: A renamed or copied file's earlier path.

binary.description: No line counts or diff: Git treats the file as binary.

turnDiff.description: GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/rewind?turn={entry_key}&path={path}: one listed file's unified diff between the run's two snapshots, as Git writes it, cut at 256 KiB (truncated). 404 when the turn has no snapshot or the file is not in its list.

request.description: POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/rewind. rewind: the conversation, the files or both back to before entry_key. switch: continue the continuation marker_key replaced, files with it when chosen. undo: undo the files-only restore marker_key. stop: a running turn is stopped first.

result.description: What the extension did. A refusal is an error: 409 turn_running, queued, busy, no_checkpoint, not_switchable, already_undone, cancelled; 404 when the message or marker is not on the active branch; 503 command_unavailable or control_uncertain (an uncertain outcome, never repeated).
